metadata.description: presence-app: give your AI a way to remember. Scriptorium writes the record; Antechamber finds it again; vault-map and work-map add shelves.

plugins.name: scriptorium
plugins.description: Turns your chat history into memories you can check, each with its exact words, source lines and real date; keeps a people roster that fills itself. Talks to your own Scriptorium server.

plugins.name: antechamber
plugins.description: One question searches every store you connect (notes, chats, memories, a vault) and returns only the best matches. Starts itself on your computer.

plugins.name: vault-map
plugins.description: Ask where you wrote about something and get the passage back, from a map of your markdown or Obsidian vault. Runs on your own computer; nothing leaves it.

plugins.name: work-map
plugins.description: Keep your project record in plain markdown lines (decisions, pipeline items) with the writer commands and a skill, and read it back as a map: what is open, waiting and recently touched. Runs on your own computer.
